TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In connection with “STAND-UP COMEDY SHOW “ at the Main Arena (Gym), Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium on 08.11.2025 & 09.11.2025, heavy footfall is expected, which may affect traffic movement around the stadium.

📍 ROADS LIKELY TO BE AFFECTED:
* IP Marg (MGM Road)
* Vikas Marg
* Ring Road from Rajghat to IP Depot

📍 ENTRY TO STADIUM:
* Gates 07 & 08 – Entry via Velodrome Road
* Gates 16, 18, 21, 22 & 23 – Entry via MGM Road

📍 PARKING:
* Limited parking for vehicles with valid parking labels only. Display label with vehicle number.
* Vehicles without valid labels will not be allowed near the stadium.
* Parking entry via MGM Road for labeled vehicles.
📍 ADVISORY:
* Avoid affected routes during 01:00 PM – 11:00 PM on show days.
* Use public transport to ease congestion.
* Vehicles parked on restricted roads will be towed.
* Follow instructions of traffic personnel on site.
📍 Stay updated via Delhi Traffic Police official channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory
